project.title: med_reminder
project.tagline: A local-first Flutter medication reminder and personal health utility app.

summary.short: med_reminder is a Flutter app for medication management and reminders with a local-first data model and an expanding personal health utility roadmap.
summary.long: Current work includes macOS usability and cleanup, medicine data improvements, reminder workflows, privacy-conscious local-first design, and future non-caregiver health features such as opt-in period tracking.
